fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: REPORTING DATE
fields.description: The code for the reporting Institution. (E.g. XYZ = 070002)

fields.name: INSTITITUTION CODE
fields.description: Institution code issued by CBK (e.g. Dahabshil = 0700001)

fields.name: CURRENCY TYPE CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: KES SPOT RATE
fields.description: The Opening exchange rate for each type of currency.The values must have at least 5 decimal places.

fields.name: OPENING POSITION AMOUNT
fields.description: Remittance opening postion for each type of currency in item 4 above where the reporting institution is a Money Remittance Provider and Purchases opening position where the reporting institution is a Forex Bureau.

fields.name: TOTAL INFLOWS AMOUNT
fields.description: Total remittance inflows for each type of currency in item 4 above for Money Remittance Providers or total purchases for Forex Bureaus.

fields.name: OTHER TOTAL INFLOWS AMOUNT
fields.description: Other total inflows for each type of currency in item 4 above.

fields.name: TOTAL OUTFLOWS AMOUNT
fields.description: Total remittance outflows for each type of currency in item 4 above for Money Remittance Providers or total sales for Forex Bureaus.

fields.name: OTHER TOTAL OUTFLOWS AMOUNT
fields.description: Other total outflows for each type of currency in item 4 above.
